- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on how to weave characters’ backstories and flashbacks into a narrative, including:
  1. Determine the purpose of the backstory or flashback.
  2. Use clear transitions to indicate shifts in narrative.
  3. Avoid info-dumps by drip-feeding information.
  4. Keep backstories and flashbacks relevant to the narrative.
  5. Make backstories and flashbacks interesting using descriptive language and dialogue.
